skill.summary: Guides reflection on personal legacy and what lasting impact one wants to leave.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Legacy Thinking Facilitator skill.
- Guides users through structured reflection exercises to clarify personal legacy and align daily decisions with core values.
- Includes practical tools: 3 Horizons Reflection, Values Erosion Audit, Legacy Intention Statement, and a 90-Day Legacy Experiment.
- Designed to support individuals during major life transitions or when seeking greater meaning and purpose.
- Emphasizes practical, non-morbid approaches to legacy and introduces digital legacy considerations.
- Part of the Personal Growth Skills collection for self-reflection and personal development.
